senses.en_definition: Is not; used to emphasize a denial or correction.

messages.en: Don't you want to help me move? You've been quiet this whole time.
It's not that I don't want to help. I'm just a bit busy right now. I can come over after three.

senses.en_definition: Not actually; used to correct an assumption, explain oneself, or introduce a contrast.

collocations.en: it's not that I don't want to

messages.en: You're not coming tonight either? It's been ages since we last hung out.
It's not that I don't want to come. I have to work tonight because we're short-staffed.
Oh, that explains it. Let me know when you've got a day off. We'll find another day.

senses.en_definition: Information, signs, or arguments that support the truth of a fact or claim.

messages.en: I've already paid. Would you like me to send the proof of payment here?
Yes, send it here, please. I'll check it first, then confirm your order.
I've sent it, sis. Let me know if you can't see it, okay?
If you've already paid, just show the receipt to prove it.
Okay, I'll send it now. The receipt's on my phone.
